content:
eli: quick note — onboarding Calypso LoRA merge for their receipts & legal text. quick eval shows spike in parentheses-loss on monetary lines (~1.9%)

nora: parentheses-loss? example?

eli: expected "(USD 1,200.00)" -> observed "USD 1,200.00" (missing parentheses) in int4 merged artifact

kevin: interesting. same tokens? logits?

eli: token ids match; beam outputs favor omission token at low prob. fp16 merged is fine. int4 baseline without LoRA also fine -> indicates fold+quant interaction

quant-bot: run summary id=qrun-3279-calypso mode=int4-perchannel leakage=0.014 token-drift=0.019

nora: can you reproduce minimal prompt with deterministic sampling?

eli: repro snippet:
```
prompt = "Amount (USD): 1200.00\nLine:"
for s in [7,8,9]:
  print(model_int4.sample(prompt, top_k=1, seed=s))
```
all seeds drop parentheses on int4 merged; fp16 keeps them

kevin: try merging in fp32 then quantize; try per-channel symmetric vs asymmetric; try runtime-apply LoRA

(45m)

eli: results:
- fp32-merge + naive quant => 1.7%
- fp32-merge + per-channel symmetric + 256 calibration => 0.4%
- runtime-apply (no fold) => 0.05%

nora: calibration helps but runtime-adapter is best. customer needs single artifact

kevin: mitigation options: bias-corr focused on punctuation tokens, re-fold in fp32 with higher accumulator precision, add tiny post-process verifier that checks for parentheses around currency using regex and reinstates if model confidence falls below threshold

eli: implemented punctuation-bias-corr (targeting tokens '(' , ')' , ',' , '.') + 512-sample numeric calibration => 0.09% parentheses-loss. added post-process verifier reduces to 0.03%

nora: propose building calypso-int4-paren-safe artifact with eval pack: 200 targeted currency prompts + 1.5k regression samples. attach merge script, quant flags, calibration seeds, and post-process verifier code. S3: s3://redwood-evals/calypso/calypso-int4-paren-safe-3279990011.tgz

kevin: add console alert metric 'paren-loss' with threshold <=0.1% and a short runbook for SE pointing out runtime-adapter tradeoffs

eli: done. uploaded artifact and README. opening ENG-ML ticket ENG-ML-5490 with owner nora

ops-bot: ticket ENG-ML-5490 created; artifact uploaded

nora: thanks team. let's schedule a 15m sync with customer and SE to go over artifact and runbook :thumbsup:
